question: Which woman is singled out as worthy of special reverence?
premises: A woman of the kula is named
She is skilled in tantra and mantra
Such a woman is to be honored
inference: A kula woman skilled in tantra and mantra is especially worthy of reverence.
uncertainties: kūla spelling differs from kula; taken as same term in this context
plain_english: O Great Goddess, a woman of the kula who is skilled in tantra and mantra...
